heading: Source
reported_value: Kaufmann, Quade, Buschmann, Chinnaraj, Birke, Rossner (2026) J. CO2 Util. 105, 103347; Univ. Stuttgart (Electrical Energy Storage Systems, Inst. for Photovoltaics)
evidence_excerpt_or_description: CO2 and CH4 conversion in a rotating DC glow to arc plasma with big discharge gap
notes: Open access CC BY; received 12 Sep 2025, online 3 Feb 2026; same group and driver lineage as Renninger 2022 (SRC022)

heading: Reactor configuration
reported_value: Stainless-steel ISO-K casing with vermiculite insulation holding a pin anode and ring cathode; gap 10-40 mm (10-50 mm in Sec. 3.1, depending on cathode diameter); permanent magnets B = 21 mT in the electrode region; axial (vertical) flow; mechanical ignition rod
evidence_excerpt_or_description: The mechanical components of the plasma reactor consist of stainless-steel ISO-K parts with inserted thermal insulation made of vermiculite ... pin anode and ring cathode. The distance is varying from 10 mm to 40 mm ... B = 21 mT
notes: No catalyst in the reported performance runs; ceramic foam used in some voltage tests (Fig. 7)

heading: Electricity supply
reported_value: Cyclize plasma driver (own customisations) with voltage-controlled current limitation, fed by an AC-DC power supply of max. 5 kW; no ballast resistor
evidence_excerpt_or_description: we use a plasma driver from Cyclize [70] in combination with our own customisations. The plasma control is based on voltage-controlled current limitation ... connected to an AC-DC power supply with a maximum power of 5 kW
basis_and_boundary: DC plasma; power-electronic current control replaces the ballast resistor
notes: Development of the Renninger et al. driver [64,65]

heading: Electricity supply
reported_value: Current probe ELDITEST CP6990 (DC-1.5 MHz, +-4% DC accuracy); HV differential probe CalTest CT4079-NA (15 kV); R&S RTB2004 oscilloscope
evidence_excerpt_or_description: A current probe CP6990 from ELDITEST is mounted across the cathode cable ... For voltage measurement a high voltage differential probe CT4079-NA
basis_and_boundary: Plasma V x I at the reactor

heading: Electricity supply
reported_value: SEI_P = P_P / V_dot (plasma power); SEI_supply = P_in / V_dot (input power at the power supply); eta_ps,pp = I_P U_P / (I_supply U_supply)
evidence_excerpt_or_description: In addition to the formula for SEI via plasma power (SEIP) commonly used in the literature, we also perform analyses in which we use the input power at the power supply via SEIsupply to extend the energy balance limit.
basis_and_boundary: Supply boundary = I_supply x U_supply at the power supply feeding the driver; whether the AC-DC stage (mains side) is included is unclear
notes: Interpreted as DC supply output / driver input (eta_ps,pp is a driver efficiency)

heading: Electricity supply
reported_value: Supply power 400 W (small gap, no rotation) to 1750 W (large gap, rotation); eta_ps,pp 88-94%; highest at dd = 40 mm and P_P = 1660 W
evidence_excerpt_or_description: The power measured at the power supply varies from 400 W at low discharge distances and without rotation to 1750 W at large distances with rotation. The efficiencies eta_ps,pp thus range from 88 % to 94 %. The highest measured efficiency is at dd = 40 mm and PP = 1660 W.
basis_and_boundary: Plasma / supply
notes: 1660 W is ~14% above SEI_P x 6 SLM at the highest-SEI point (C004); abstract gives 400-1700 W

heading: Operating conditions
reported_value: 6 SLM total; CO2/CH4 50/50 and 60/40 (molar); N2 (10%) only in initial runs to fit alpha
evidence_excerpt_or_description: The experiments are carried out with a volume flow of 6 SLM and an adjusted molar rate of Carbon Dioxide, Methane and Nitrogen ... The volume flow was kept constant at 6 SLM
basis_and_boundary: SLM reference conditions not stated
